title: 921. Shortest Bridge

examples.explanation: One diagonal gap needs a single flip.
The gap spans two water cells.
The inner cell is one step from the ring.

hints: Paint the first island and push all its cells as layer zero of a multi-source search.
Expand outward one ring at a time over water, skipping already seen cells.
The first time the expansion touches the second island, the layer count is the answer.
